etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English rebellioun, rebellion, from Old French rebellion, from Latin rebelliō. Also see -ion.

definitions.definition: (uncountable) Armed resistance to an established government or ruler.
(countable) Defiance of authority or control; the act of rebelling.
(countable) An organized, forceful subversion of the law of the land in an attempt to replace it with another form of government.
